description: This file defines the CardReaderFragment class, a fragment responsible for managing NFC card reading functionality within an Android application. It handles UI initialization, NFC reader mode management, and callback handling for reading loyalty card accounts.

classes.name: CardReaderFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing NFC card reading, UI updates, and lifecycle handling for a loyalty card reader feature.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment; standard Android lifecycle method.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the UI layout, initializes UI components and NFC reader, and sets up the environment.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disables NFC reader mode when fragment is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Enables NFC reader mode when fragment is resumed.

methods.name: enableReaderMode
methods.description: Activates NFC reader mode with specific flags and logs the action.

methods.name: disableReaderMode
methods.description: Deactivates NFC reader mode and logs the action.

methods.name: onAccountReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when an NFC tag's account data is read; updates the UI on the main thread.
